pack.title: Discord Data Pack
pack.subtitle: Select the extracted folder from your Discord privacy pack (not the ZIP file). The pack should contain a Messages/ folder.
pack.errorNotFound: Folder "Messages" not found in pack. Make sure you selected the extracted (not ZIP) Discord pack folder.

review.title: Message Review
review.empty: Load a data pack to see messages.

progress.title: Deleting Messages
progress.logBatchBreak: ⏸ Batch {index}/{total} done — break ~{mins} min before next batch

settings.title: Settings
settings.tokenHint: You can find your token in the browser or Discord app DevTools (Network tab → requests to discord.com → Authorization header).
settings.delayHint: Minimum 1 second. Too short a delay may result in rate-limiting or account ban.
settings.noTokenAlert: No token! Configure your token in Settings.
settings.batchEnabledHint: When enabled, messages are split into random-sized batches with long random breaks between them. This mimics human behavior and reduces ban risk.
settings.batchHint: Each batch will have a random size between min and max. Breaks between batches are also randomized. Example: batches of 487, 567, 456… with 37min, 94min… breaks.
settings.historyHint: Save a JSON file that tracks which messages have already been deleted. Load it on the next session to skip already-deleted messages automatically. History is autosaved every 20 successful deletions.
